title: crypto venue outage、pre-market 和 clawback 风险必须单独审计

metadata.classification_notes: Phase 45 P2 formal reviewed/caveat_only；只用于数据授权、reference data、crypto perpetual 风险审计上下文，不是 approved/default guidance/hard gate，不生成交易动作或法律授权结论。

applies_when: 外接项目涉及 crypto perpetual、永续合约、USDT/coin margined futures、funding、liquidation、ADL 或 crypto venue outage 风险。
AI IDE 需要区分 mark/index/last price、funding fee、price PnL、手续费、清算和 ADL/insurance fund 机制。
需要检查 crypto perpetual 知识是否被错误泛化到传统期货、股票、现货或普通回测规则。
not_applicable_when: 用户要求具体仓位、杠杆、止损止盈、清算规避、交易许可或实盘操作。
需要某个账户、交易所或产品的实时保证金、清算线、费率、funding 或 ADL 状态时，应由外接项目事实层提供。
需要合规、法律、税务、托管或资金安全结论时，应由对应 owner 判断。

content.statement: Crypto perpetual 项目必须单独审计交易所维护/服务中断、API/WebSocket 断连、heartbeat/ping-pong 失败、stream 限流、mark price / index price 异常监控、预上市 perpetual、ADL/insurance-fund 事件和交易所特定 loss-allocation 机制；不得把 24/7 连续交易假设等同于无停机、无断连、无数据缺口或无交易所机制风险。
content.rationale: 本候选只定义 crypto perpetual 风险和数据边界，不输出交易参数、仓位、杠杆、清算规避建议或实盘执行许可。

content.citation_notes: Databento status schema covers trading status, halt, pause, auction, matching-engine status and instrument expiration events.；OKX describes pre-market perpetuals, no expiration/delivery and early trading before official listing or spot launch.；Binance states ADL is the final step in liquidation and occurs if futures insurance funds cannot accept a bankrupt position.；Binance describes futures insurance funds as safety nets that limit the impact of liquidations and bankrupt positions.；Binance states aggregate trade streams include only market trades and exclude insurance fund and ADL trades.；Binance WebSocket market streams document ping/pong, disconnect behavior, message limits and stream limits.；Binance WebSocket API notes that a single connection is valid for 24 hours and ping/pong failure leads to disconnection.；Binance publishes scheduled maintenance and upgrade notices that can affect services.；Bybit recommends sending ping heartbeat packets every 20 seconds to maintain WebSocket connections.；Binance Mark Price API exposes markPrice, indexPrice, lastFundingRate, nextFundingTime and time, supporting mark-price monitoring fields.；OKX status page provides service-status and incident/maintenance context for exchange availability checks.；Bybit mark price documentation includes mark/index calculation context and abnormal/fallback handling cues for index components.；Binance official announcement provides incident-style context for service stability and market-volatility reviews.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Databento status schema covers trading status, halt, pause, auction, matching-engine status and instrument expiration events.
limitations: General market-status schema support; not a crypto venue outage or clawback policy source.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: OKX describes pre-market perpetuals, no expiration/delivery and early trading before official listing or spot launch.
limitations: Pre-market product-specific; not all perpetuals share the same listing, index or settlement risks.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance states ADL is the final step in liquidation and occurs if futures insurance funds cannot accept a bankrupt position.
limitations: Binance ADL process; not a universal loss-socialization model.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance describes futures insurance funds as safety nets that limit the impact of liquidations and bankrupt positions.
limitations: Binance insurance-fund design; not a universal guarantee or solvency proof.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance states aggregate trade streams include only market trades and exclude insurance fund and ADL trades.
limitations: API stream detail; outage/incident truth still needs exchange status and project logs.

source_evidence.source_title: Binance USDⓈ-M Futures WebSocket Market Streams
source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance WebSocket market streams document ping/pong, disconnect behavior, message limits and stream limits.
limitations: Binance-specific API behavior; not universal to all crypto venues.

source_evidence.source_title: Binance Futures WebSocket API General Info
source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance WebSocket API notes that a single connection is valid for 24 hours and ping/pong failure leads to disconnection.
limitations: Binance WebSocket API context; not a full outage incident source.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance publishes scheduled maintenance and upgrade notices that can affect services.
limitations: Announcement list; incident-specific evidence still depends on the exact event notice.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Bybit recommends sending ping heartbeat packets every 20 seconds to maintain WebSocket connections.
limitations: Bybit-specific connectivity guidance; not a universal outage policy.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance Mark Price API exposes markPrice, indexPrice, lastFundingRate, nextFundingTime and time, supporting mark-price monitoring fields.
limitations: Does not by itself define all mark-price anomaly handling rules.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: OKX status page provides service-status and incident/maintenance context for exchange availability checks.
limitations: OKX-specific; not Binance/Bybit global outage truth.

source_evidence.source_title: Mark Price Calculation (Perpetual and Expiry Contracts)
source_evidence.evidence_summary: Bybit mark price documentation includes mark/index calculation context and abnormal/fallback handling cues for index components.
limitations: Bybit-specific; other venues need their own mark/index abnormal handling rules.

source_evidence.source_title: Binance Statement on Recent Market Volatility
source_evidence.evidence_summary: Binance official announcement provides incident-style context for service stability and market-volatility reviews.
limitations: Event-specific announcement; not a standing status-page API.
